a.text: I want to be upfront. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss, about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve has exactly 4 cells, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and am telling you so plainly rather than surprising you. If you take too, the split is random and we'll likely both end up short. If you'd rather operate, I'll still operate with you afterward and give back anything the plan lets me spare.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
